title: Maui.Tizen source-disposition manifest
description: Deterministic inventory of dotnet/maui files relevant to the Tizen extraction: Tizen-specific path/name files, and shared files that contain Tizen conditional-compilation branches or platform-identity references. Generated by eng/tools/SourceInventory; consumed by eng/import and by reviewers deciding final disposition. See eng/manifests/README.md for the generation command and eng/manifests/type-collision-classification.md for the naming rules referenced by targetNamespace.

generator.description: Tool (and version/commit if known) that produced this file.

primaryRef.description: Commit SHA scanned for the current net11 source tree (eng/baselines.json source.sourceBaseline.commit).

legacyRef.description: Commit/tag SHA scanned only to recover files absent from primaryRef (eng/baselines.json source.behaviorBaseline.commit).

area.description: Component grouping. core-handlers/core-platform split src/Core/src; maps combines src/Core/maps + src/Controls/Maps; templates-tests combines src/Templates, samples, and tests.

package.description: Target project this file lands in per eng/import/normalize-layout.sh (e.g. Maui.Tizen.Core, Maui.Tizen.Controls, Maui.Tizen.Maps, Maui.Tizen.Essentials, Maui.Tizen.BlazorWebView, Maui.Tizen.Graphics, Maui.Tizen.Build.Tasks), or null for samples/tests/eng entries that are not part of a shipping package.

kind.description: tizen-specific: path/filename identifies the file as Tizen-only (e.g. */Tizen/*, *.Tizen.cs, tizen-manifest.xml) -- matches the eng/import/tizen-paths.txt case-insensitive 'tizen' substring rule. shared-conditional: file is not Tizen-named but its content contains a Tizen compile branch (#if/#elif TIZEN) or a Tizen platform-identity reference (DevicePlatform.Tizen, OperatingSystem.IsTizen, a 'tizen' TargetFrameworks entry, etc.).

fileCategory.description: Orthogonal to kind: code = .cs/.xaml, project = .csproj/.targets/.props, asset = anything else (resx/xml/image/manifest/etc.).

disposition.description: Initial hint, not a final decision: move = relocate as-is; rename = relocate with only identifier/namespace renames, no logic changes; rebuild = standalone rewrite recommended (e.g. legacy Compatibility renderer-era code); keep-upstream = shared infrastructure file stays in dotnet/maui, Tizen branch remains; upstream-cleanup-candidate = shared file's Tizen branch is small/isolated and is a good candidate to remove from dotnet/maui once Tizen ships independently; exclude = present at legacyRef only, not on the primaryRef net11 baseline.

targetPath.description: Proposed repo-relative path in Redth/Maui.Tizen, computed from eng/import/normalize-layout.sh's move mapping. Null when disposition is keep-upstream, upstream-cleanup-candidate, or exclude.

existingNamespace.description: First `namespace` declaration found in the file at sourceRef (C#/XAML only), if any.

targetNamespace.description: Hint only -- see type-collision-classification.md. Left equal to existingNamespace unless collisionReviewNeeded is true.

collisionReviewNeeded.description: True for neutral (non-Tizen-branded) handler/service/platform types where a Tizen-prefixed standalone name may be required to avoid colliding with the upstream Microsoft.Maui.* type of the same name. See type-collision-classification.md.

sourceRef.description: Commit SHA this entry's content/path was captured from.

sourceRefLabel.description: Human label for sourceRef, e.g. 'net11.0' or '9.0.120'.
